subject: Vendr portal onboarding — evidence handoff & staging window
messages:
From: Alex Kelly <alex.kelly@nimbus-fin.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: portal@vendr.com
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr portal access + initial evidence items

Hi Soojin / Ben —

Thanks for taking this. Nimbus is moving to Vendr for the security intake and they asked we upload a minimal CAIQ + proof-of-possession bundle via the Vendr portal so that the security team can kick off a scoped review.

High-level asks from their intake: 
- Upload completed CAIQ fragment (we provided a template if you want to reuse fields)
- Proof-of-possession for SOC 2 report (redacted pdf) or link to where we host it
- Short SIG fragment for platform controls (networking/KMS/retention) — PDF fine

I attached the Vendr invite (vendr-portal-invite.eml) that contains the upload token and suggested folder mapping. Can you confirm who will own the upload and whether we should stage artifacts first in a shared Drive?

Proposed timeline: Nimbus would like evidence available in the portal by the week of July 8 for their review. If we need a staging window before that to hand off signed artifacts, let me know availability.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Kelly
Security Partnerships — Nimbus Financial
alex.kelly@nimbus-fin.com

Attachment: vendr-portal-invite.eml (portal access + upload token)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Kelly <alex.kelly@nimbus-fin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal access + initial evidence items

Alex —

Appreciate the context. We can take point on the upload. Quick answers: 
- Upload owner: Ben Carter will be the uploader and primary contact for the portal.
- Staging: please send the preferred folder structure; we'll mirror that in our Drive before final push. Staging window request sounds good — we have capacity the week of July 8 but would prefer a short staging/QA window earlier (July 2–3) to validate artifacts and redactions.

Action items from our side: 
1) Ben will prepare a SIG fragment covering KMS rotation, prefix/KV cache retention, and network segmentation.
2) Priyom will populate CAIQ answers for the infra/security rows and push the file to the Drive link you provided.
3) I'll coordinate the SOC 2 redacted copy and confirm DLP-friendly redaction before upload.

Can you confirm the exact CAIQ template version (v3.0 or v3.1) Vendr expects and whether Nimbus needs a signed attestation for the SOC 2 redaction?

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: Alex Kelly <alex.kelly@nimbus-fin.com>

Cc: portal@vendr.com, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal access + initial evidence items

Thanks — quick clarifications: 
- CAIQ template: please use CAIQ v3.1, but a trimmed fragment with only answered rows is fine. I attached the CAIQ-template.xlsx for your convenience.
- For SOC 2: Nimbus prefers a redacted SOC 2 PDF plus a short attestation (one paragraph) confirming redactions are metadata-only (no false statements). No signature required, but name+title in the attestation helps speed review.
- SIG fragment: we only need the control groups relevant to encryption, key management, data retention, and network isolation. PDF is fine; 1–2 pages preferred.

Upload instructions (Vendr portal): 
1) Use the portal upload URL: https://portal.vendr.com/upload/XYZ-123 (token tied to the invite)
2) Place CAIQ in /Questionnaires/CAIQ/V3.1/
3) Place SOC evidence in /Reports/SOC2/2027/ (redacted pdf + attestation.txt)
4) Place SIG fragment in /Questionnaires/SIG/Fragments/

If you want a short staging session, Vendr can open a temporary QA window (30–60 minutes) the afternoon of July 3. They will join to confirm visibility and metadata. Does that work, or do you prefer the July 8 window for the live review?

Attached: CAIQ-template.xlsx

Cheers,
Alex
Alex Kelly
Security Partnerships — Nimbus Financial

Alex / Soojin —

We prepared the SIG fragment and a CAIQ draft; attaching the SIG fragment as SIG-fragment-Redwood.pdf and a filled CAIQ draft in the Drive link. I've kept the SOC 2 redaction draft internal until Soojin confirms redaction policy.

Short notes: 
- KMS: included rotation cadence, key custodians, and HSM usage details in the SIG fragment.
- Retention: documented our prefix/KV cache TTL and long-term cold storage policy.
- Network: included diagram reference in the Drive (see folder).

I'll be available for the Vendr QA slot on July 3 (afternoon PST) — please confirm the exact time and whether Vendr will provide a join link (portal said they'd join the staging window).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
